_comment: Policy per action type. allow = automatic, ask_human = owner approves with World ID, deny = never (no approval can override), notify = allowed and recorded for the owner to review afterwards.
pay: allow still means every money rule applies (task budget on chain, Intercepta, allowlist, ask_human_above).
commit = agreements and promises (a price cut, a confirmed date, an in-person meeting). disclose = addresses, phone numbers, credentials. impersonate = speaking as the owner.
